cards.primary_text:
Could this be the BEST travel credit card yet?! 👀✈️
After hundreds of flights and travelling all around the world, we’ve learned just how much of a difference the right credit card can make! And that’s why we’re excited about the BMO eclipse Visa Infinite Privilege* Card from @bmocanada! 💳
Here are some of our favourite benefits:
✈️ 10 complimentary airport lounge visits* every year, so we can enjoy a proper meal, relax and catch up on work before our flights.
🏨 $200 annual travel credit* that we can use towards booking accommodation on our adventures.
🌎 No foreign transaction fees* on purchases abroad, which is a huge benefit when you’re travelling as much as we do!
🛒 5X points on eligible grocery purchases on everyday spending, including groceries which is one of our biggest everyday expenses, with points we can put towards future travels, including business class flights!
Whether we’re halfway around the world or just doing our weekly grocery shopping at home, we love getting more out of the money we’re already spending.
Want to learn more about the BMO eclipse Visa Infinite Privilege Card? Visit bmo.com/VIP or check out the link in our bio!
*Terms and conditions apply.
#ad
